summary: Full end-to-end verification of Landing Page Builder route_grid block (armada-bandara template). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASSED (routes[] source, template contains route_grid with canonical props, POST/PATCH preserves props without warnings, publish + public payload contains route_grid, regression template armada-konversi still works). Frontend: template->editor loads with 3 REAL routes from /api/public/booking/config (BDO-CGK Rp950.000, CGK-BDO Rp950.000, BDO-KJT Rp700.000), form fields (lp-prop-limit / lp-prop-showprice / lp-route-ids with 3 trt_* checkboxes) work, selecting checkbox filters preview to that route. Save + Publish succeeded, public /lp/{slug} rendered route_grid, clicking public 'Pesan rute ini' card navigated to /booking?service=airport_transfer&route=trt_83d216d8efa14331&lp=... and booking wizard's data-testid booking-route showed the preselected route label 'Bandung → Soekarno-Hatta (CGK) · dari Rp 950.000'. Regression /lp/sewa-hiace-jakarta renders normally. All test-created landing pages deleted (final list confirmed empty).
critical_code_review_comments: lp-add-block is rendered as a shadcn Select (not native <select>), so playwright select_option cannot drive it directly; consider adding a data-testid on each option (e.g. lp-add-block-option-route_grid) to make QA scripts robust. Not a functional bug — manual add-block was confirmed working by main agent's smoke test.
seed_data_creation: None — only ephemeral landing pages created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: route_grid block ships with canonical props {title, subtitle, ids, limit, show_price, cta}. Data source: GET /api/public/booking/config → routes[] (fields id trt_*, from_label, to_label, from_price, code, duration_minutes). Public card renders as a <button data-testid=lp-route-{id}> (not <a>) — click it directly rather than looking for inner <a>. Login uses data-testid login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button and stores JWT in localStorage key 'tf_token'. Seed public page /lp/sewa-hiace-jakarta must remain intact after cleanup.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verified end-to-end without defects.
